en-US:
Separate Enhanced background, Picture in Picture and Screen feedback switches. Feedback and task progress share one PiP window; progress remains visible when valid feedback is unavailable.

Try Settings → Background execution → Sound and narration: rain, brown noise, volume, task narration and cues. Ambient sound starts enabled at zero volume; raise the slider to listen. Check pause/resume, task completion, PiP closure, voice input and saved preferences.

Office shows live ink and saved ink in Notes covers. This build corrects Word stroke placement, including rapid consecutive strokes. Use file copies, save and reopen, and report real Pencil feel.

Known ongoing work: two-finger zoom with drawing enabled has not passed actual UIKit interaction acceptance and remains under investigation.
zh-Hans:
增强后台、画中画、录屏反馈改为独立开关。反馈和任务进度共用一个画中画窗口；没有有效反馈时继续显示任务进度。

请在“设置 → 后台运行 → 声音与播报”测试雨声、棕噪声、音量、任务播报和提示音。背景音初始开启、零音量，调高滑块即可收听。重点检查暂停恢复、任务结束、关闭画中画、语音输入和偏好保留。

Office 支持实时笔迹及手记缩略图中的已保存笔迹；本构建修正 Word 笔迹落点，包括连续快速书写。请使用文件副本，保存重开并反馈真实 Pencil 手感。

仍在处理：画笔模式下双指缩放尚未通过真实 UIKit 交互验收，继续单独修复。
